name: What preparations do I need to make before wainscoting installation?

mainEntity.name: What preparations do I need to make before wainscoting installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before wainscoting installation, it's beneficial to clear the walls of any décor, furniture, or obstacles to allow easy access for our team. If you plan to paint the walls above the wainscoting, completing that step beforehand can simplify the process. Ensure electrical outlets and light switches along the wall are accessible, as some adjustments may be needed. Our team will handle the fine details, but clearing the space helps ensure a smooth and efficient installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before wainscoting installation, clear walls of furniture and décor. Consider painting the upper walls beforehand for efficiency.
